p: at all times: He promised never to become unmindful of God's great benefit for his deliverance.
humble shall hear thereof: They who are beaten down with the experience of their own evils.
fears: Which I conceived for the danger I was in.
looked unto him: They will be bold to flee to you for help, when they see your mercies toward me.
angel of the LORD encampeth round: Though God's power is sufficient to govern us, yet for man's infirmity he appoints his angels to watch over us.
lions do lack: The godly by their patient obedience profit more than they who ravage and spoil.
want any good thing: If they abide the last trial.
fear of the LORD: That is, the true religion and worship of God.
see good: Seeing all men naturally desire happiness, he wonders why they cast themselves willingly into misery.
face of the LORD is against: The anger of God not only destroys the wicked, but also abolishes their name forever.
broken heart: When they seem to be swallowed up with afflictions, then God is at hand to deliver them.
He keepeth all his bones: And as Christ says, all the hairs of his head.
wicked: Their wicked enterprises will turn to their own destruction.
redeemeth the soul of his servants: For when they seem to be overcome with great dangers and death itself, then God shows himself as their redeemer.
